m.s: Peel {potato} and cut into even chunks. Boil in salted water for 15 to 18 minutes until a knife slides through. Drain well, then mash with {butter}, {milk} and a good pinch of salt until smooth.

While the potatoes cook, heat a drizzle of oil in a large deep frying pan over high heat. Cook {beef_mince} for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until well browned. Add finely diced {onion} and {carrot} and cook for 8 minutes over medium heat until soft.
Stir in crushed {garlic} and {tompaste} for 2 minutes. Add {worcestershire} and {stockpowder} dissolved in ½ cup hot water per serve.
Simmer for 15 minutes, then stir in {peas}. Mix {cornflour} with a splash of cold water, stir it in and bubble for 1 minute until thick. Season well. Heat the oven to 200°C.
Spoon the filling into a baking dish and spread the mash over the top. Rough it up with a fork, as the ridges go crispy, then scatter over {cheese}.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

l: Cut into portions once cool. Reheats perfectly. Keeps 3 days in the fridge, and it freezes well.
g: Check the Worcestershire sauce (some aren't GF), the stock powder and the cornflour (100% maize).
